newsitem.title: INDIA: Societe Generale cuts Indian prime rate to 16 pct.
newsitem.headline: Societe Generale cuts Indian prime rate to 16 pct.

text.p: Societe Generale said on Monday it will cut its Indian prime lending rate to 16 percent per annum from 17 percent with effect from May 1.
The rate is exclusive of interest tax, a bank official told Reuters.
The spread over the prime rate remains unchanged at three percentage points, he said.
The rate cut follows measures announced by the Reserve Bank of India to reduce deposit rates in its monetary policy for first half 1997/98 (April-March) released on April 15.
